name: @pipeworx/mcp-dnd5e

tools.name: get_spell
tools.description: Get spell details including damage, range, duration, components, and effects. Provide spell index (e.g., "fireball", "magic-missile", "cure-wounds"). Returns damage dice, range, casting time, and effect descriptions.

tools.name: get_monster
tools.description: Get monster stats including AC, HP, abilities, skills, senses, and actions. Provide monster index (e.g., "aboleth", "dragon-red-adult", "goblin"). Returns ability scores, skill bonuses, and attack/action details.

tools.name: get_class
tools.description: Get class features, hit dice, proficiencies, and advancement tables. Provide class index (e.g., "barbarian", "wizard", "rogue"). Returns feature progression, proficiency gains, and subclass options.

tools.name: list_spells
tools.description: Search D&D 5e spells by name or level. Returns spell indices, names, and levels for use with get_spell to fetch full details.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dnd5e forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dnd5e pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
